candidate.blueprint_topic: Care coordination and referral to interdisciplinary pulmonary rehabilitation
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize pulmonary rehabilitation as an interdisciplinary, exercise- and education-based intervention recommended for adults with stable COPD to improve important functional and quality-of-life outcomes.

options.A: It is a comprehensive program that includes individualized exercise training and self-management education and can improve exercise capacity and health-related quality of life
options.B: It consists primarily of medication adjustment and excludes structured exercise training
options.C: It is recommended only after a client develops end-stage COPD with severe lung-function impairment
options.D: It has no established role for adults with stable COPD unless they were recently hospitalized

candidate.rationale: A is correct. The 2023 official American Thoracic Society clinical practice guideline defines pulmonary rehabilitation as a comprehensive intervention that includes patient-tailored therapies such as exercise training, education, and behavior change; core components include structured, progressive, individually tailored exercise training and self-management education. For adults with stable COPD, ATS gives a strong recommendation for pulmonary rehabilitation based on moderate-quality evidence and notes improvements in exercise capacity and health-related quality of life. B, C, and D conflict with the guideline: exercise is a core component, the stable-COPD recommendation is not limited to end-stage disease, and pulmonary rehabilitation is recommended both for stable COPD and after hospitalization for an exacerbation.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The current official ATS guideline directly supports pulmonary rehabilitation's exercise/education components and its strong recommendation and functional/quality-of-life benefits for adults with stable COPD.
candidate.source_document_title: Pulmonary Rehabilitation for Adults with Chronic Respiratory Disease: An Official American Thoracic Society Clinical Practice Guideline
candidate.source_locator: Introduction: pulmonary rehabilitation definition and core components include structured progressive individualized exercise training and self-management education.
